program_comparison.1_entry: Select a discontinuous daily reopening jump response. The first observed completed minute after a cross-date market closure owns an opportunity; a nonlinear two-action model learns continuation versus reversal of that jump from full counterfactual market paths. This is independent of old scheduled Cross, accepted-trade scores and continuous activity-bucket hidden states.
program_comparison.2_external: No external event/index/news data. Reopening timestamps and all features are original native US30 prices and their existing server epochs.
program_comparison.3_order_time: Passive placement and market wait remain closed. Original strategy independence/causal slot-reservation study also already closed; no queue/reservation rescue. Reopening is a new signal-generating discontinuity, not retiming an existing accepted order.
program_comparison.4_management: Continuation and stop-ratchet overlays remain closed. New independent jump strategy has its own frozen symmetric first-passage and time exit; none of the five preserved original engines has an exit overlay.
program_comparison.5_capital: Daily-weight and independent relative-value book bundles remain closed. No hedge, capital weight, risk ladder or blocked-signal allocation variant opens.
program_comparison.7_meta: Original admission facts are supporting coverage evidence only. Accepted-trade-only labels cannot cover abstained opportunities; new jump action labels will observe all eligible market events regardless actual trade. No separate diagnostic/safety/checker project.

distinctness: New causal event is a cross-date quote discontinuity following at least 30 minutes without an observed bar. It is not an alternative clock or feature transform of old Cross/HMM opportunities, not a shifted original entry, and not a pair/spread rescue. The original Passive strategy alone is replaced; five original engines remain. A new 6-to-8-to-2 nonlinear ONNX learns two complete price-path action outcomes, never old candidate parameters or accepted-trade labels.
selection_scope: Whole STATIC/ONLINE bundle once; no adjacent closure length, feature, model, hidden width, optimizer, action, horizon, barrier, symbol, component or sizing rescue after closure.
